headline: Teachers Pay Teachers, a marketplace where teachers buy and sell classroom materials, plans to ban AI-generated resources after Chalkbeat found low-quality examples for sale.
score_reason: Pool score kept: a clear policy change in a widely used education marketplace.
importance_line: Teachers who buy classroom materials and sellers who earn income from them are affected, but the ban is still being built and the article does not say how TPT will tell AI-made material from human-made.
summary: Chalkbeat reports that Teachers Pay Teachers (TPT) told sellers at a town hall last week it will ban AI-generated resources and is building tools to find and remove them, after Chalkbeat found apparent “AI slop” such as an alphabet worksheet missing the letter F. Spokeswoman Sarah Lehman said the policy supports educators “in keeping teachers’ expertise at the heart of the marketplace”, while some sellers have protested with an online petition.
notes: The announcement was last week; Chalkbeat’s article is the first report we have.
